text:
Ivy: Quick ask — need a one-page "quickshot" the AE team can email: secure inference + SLA highlights + one micro-benchmark + clear routing snippet. Figma draft: https://redwood.app/figma/quickshot-secure

Marco: Nice. Recommend 4 micro-panels: 1) single-line outcome, 2) security + compliance badges, 3) bench stat box, 4) routing + CTA. Keep the file <250KB PDF.

Priya: Bench owner here. Latest run (2026-04-10): text-gen-4-lite @512 tokens p95 = 58ms on Dedicated; median cost per 1k tokens = $0.36. Self-host samples we collected average ~$0.65/k. Claimable delta ~45% lower unit cost. I'll add the CSV to Drive with methodology notes.

Ivy: Excellent — we'll call that out as a single stat card: "p95 58ms | ~45% lower cost vs typical self-host". Add a tiny footnote linking to bench appendix.

Marco: For the field playbook include a copy-paste inbound routing snippet. Use something concise that sales/devs can drop into docs. Also add a one-line about model-fallbacks (hosted -> dedicated -> private; compatible quantized variants).

Priya: Routing snippet (pasteable):

```
# inbound routing snippet
if customer.region == 'NA' and customer.compliance == 'standard':
    route = 'hosted-api'
elif customer.commitment_monthly >= 40000 or customer.latency_sla == 'p95<=100ms':
    route = 'dedicated-reservation'
elif customer.requires_isolation or customer.data_residency == 'on-prem':
    route = 'private-deploy'
else:
    route = 'hosted-api'
```

DeskBot: Landing template created: https://redwood.app/landing/quickshot-secure. I can schedule announcement for Apr 28 09:30 PT if final assets land by Apr 24 EOD.

Ivy: Also propose a micro A/B headline test on the landing: Variant 1 = "Secure inference with enterprise SLAs" vs Variant 2 = "Faster, cheaper private inference" — track CTR and gated-download conversion. Marco, can you wire the A/B in Opti?

Marco: Will do. Also suggest a short social explainer (25-30s) script and a hero image focused on "private VPC" + small console screenshot (observability).

Priya: Adding FAQ bullets: SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA (as applicable), KMS/HSM support, audit logs retention and export. I'll include a one-line about Console observability: "Token-level cost breakdown + per-route p95 charts".

Ivy: Deliverables & owners: Ivy = final copy + quickshot layout; Priya = bench appendix + CSV + FAQ; Marco = A/B headline + landing + social assets; DeskBot = landing + scheduling; SalesOps = field playbook + gated form fields.

SalesOps: I'll add gated fields: company, role, compliance needs, expected QPS, preferred deployment. Also preparing a 3-email nurture sequence: security deep-dive, cost model, replay + customer story.

Ivy: Great. I'll post the first PDF draft here on Apr 23 for a 24-hour review window. Thanks everyone :rocket:
